pages.title: Axiomatic Breach Engine
pages.text: Note to self: this machine breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart and you fall out of reality.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

Two ways through. Forge an $(item)Axiom Key$() here - it is reusable, and takes you to Hyperdimensional Reality Space and back. Or run $(thing)Open Breach$() and, while the engine runs, simply walk into its centre.
First crossing. Inside, reality shatters into shards that each obey different laws. I took a step and the rules changed under my boots. I am still not sure which laws I was standing in.

pages.name: Axiomatic Breach Engine
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Axiom Key, Paradox Residue.
Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiomatic Breach Engine$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Axiom Key$(): Absolute Notes III, Axiom Key, Omnilex
